corrections.old_text: [፫] ሉቃ ፫ ፮ እንዲህ ብሎ በም↵
corrections.corrected_text: [፫] ሉቃ ፰ ፬ እንዲህ ብሎ በም↵
corrections.reason: The cross-reference to the Parable of the Sower in Luke is Luke 8:4 (ሉቃ ፰ ፬), where ፰ and ፬ were misread as ፫ and ፮.
In the image, 'እንዲህ አውቆ' (parallel to L13 'ትንቢቱን አውቆ አናግሯል') is printed, with a faint 'ህ' and 'አውቆ' misread as 'ባወቀ'.
In the printed Ge'ez text (Matthew 13:5), the nominative/adjectival form is 6th order 'ብዙኅ' (modifying መሬት), with the left leg hook of ኅ clearly visible.
